layers.note: Open colonies of rosettes among shrubs and grass.

moisture.note: Dry rocky slopes, grassland and woodland; FEIS: 76 to 650 mm of rain a year, in winter and summer.

elevation_m.note: 610 to 2,438 m (FEIS); 400 to 2,500 m for var. baccata (Flora of North America); 3,000 to 8,000 feet in Arizona, absent from the lower deserts (Kearney and Peebles). The bajada is at its lower edge.

shade_tolerance.note: FEIS: does well in partially shaded environments, unlike other yuccas.

coldest_c.note: Across its range, coldest-month means from about −3 to 11.5 °C; gone below −7 °C and above 14 °C.

hard_freeze_c.note: Across its range, lows to about −24 °C borne, gone where the year's coldest night falls below about −30 °C.

warmest_c.note: Across its range, warmest-month means from about 21 to 31.5 °C; gone below 18 °C, where summers are too short, and above 34 °C.

degree_days_0.note: About 3,000 to 7,800 degree-days above 0 °C, none below 2,200.

degree_days_5.note: About 1,600 to 6,000 degree-days above 5 °C, none below 1,000.

moisture_index.note: A moisture index from about 0.12 to 0.6, gone by 0.08 and above 0.75.

summer_rain.note: Needs the monsoon's summer rain: from about 0.15 of the year's precipitation in summer, gone below 0.05; up to about 0.6, gone by 0.7.

provenance.notes: Authored for the Saguaro desert scene (the west bajada of Saguaro National Park's Tucson Mountain District, about 750 m, 32.25 N 111.17 W) from general knowledge of the species and the ranges, habitats and elevations in the sources read for its spec (2026-10-19). Banana yucca grows from southern Colorado and Utah to Nevada, southern California, Arizona, New Mexico, western Texas and Chihuahua (FEIS; Flora of North America). Each climate range brackets the climate of that range, an approximate envelope read from these descriptions, not fitted to occurrence records; every full range holds the bajada's climate (coldest month about 11 °C, warmest about 31 °C, about 7,600 degree-days above 0 °C, coldest night about −4 °C, moisture index about 0.15, about half the year's rain in summer).
